11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager has accomplished something small but personally important: tell a friend, or keep it private.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has accomplished something personally important. It isn't particularly impressive to anyone else, and (subject.he/she) has no desire to announce it. Still, (subject) feels quietly pleased.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: "That's wonderful," says (friend). (subject) smiles. "It's a small thing." "It matters to you," replies (friend). They share a little fruit in celebration.

text_only.reason: a celebration in the story (a feast, a moment of joy); no village celebration happens in the game
